# AURA — A&R Utility & Revenue Assistant

> AURA is the operational hub for independent record labels. It centralises artist management, release pipelines, contract lifecycle, demo inbox management, promo campaign coordination, calendar scheduling, revenue tracking, and AI-assisted content generation — all from a single, dark-themed, mobile-first dashboard.

AURA is a single-page application (React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS v4) served at `https://auralabels.app`. The app is JWT-auth-gated behind a login screen; the login page is the only public-accessible surface. All authenticated routes render behind the same `index.html` shell with client-side routing.

## Project

- [Homepage](https://auralabels.app): Login page — the entry point for authenticated label operators.
- [Source code](https://github.com/gtnorbeat/aura-labels-app): Monorepo containing the React SPA, Cloudflare Worker API backend, and Drizzle ORM schemas for Neon Postgres.

## API

The API is served from the same origin (`/api/*`) via a Cloudflare Worker backend. All endpoints except `/api/login`, `/api/health`, and `/api/beta-applications` require a Bearer JWT token.

- [API health check](https://auralabels.app/api/health): Returns a JSON health status.
- [API login](https://auralabels.app/api/login): POST endpoint for JWT authentication (username + password).

## Optional

- [Robots.txt](https://auralabels.app/robots.txt): Crawler access policy — allows only the root `/` path; all auth-gated SPA routes are disallowed.
